landing.heroSubtitle: Tidyondzo leti tirhisanaka na thiyori, khodi leyi hlamuseriweke, na swikambelwana swa nkarhi wolowo — hinkwaswo hi nkarhi wa xiviri.
landing.feature1Desc: Vuxokoxoko bya markdown byo fuwa lebyi nga na swiphemu swa khodi leswi voningisiweke na tinhlamuselo leti tirhisanaka.
landing.feature2Desc: Tlhoma eka layini yin'wana na yin'wana leyi voningisiweke leswaku u kuma nhlamuselo leyi heleleke ya leswi yi swi endlaka.
landing.feature3Desc: Swikambelo swa nkarhi swo fana na Kahoot, leswi nga na ku hlayela ka xihatla na xikombiso xa lava rhangelaka.
landing.feature4Desc: Fambisa xiyimiso xa nkarhi wolowo naswona u kongomisa vadyondzi goza hi goza — switirhisiwa hinkwaswo swi pfuxetiwa hi nkarhi wolowo.
landing.howItWorksTitle: Ndlela leyi swi tirhaka ha yona
landing.step1: Tumbuluxa ntlangu wa wena hi switeji swa tidyondzo na swikambelwana.
